prompt: Change shift totals to round the elapsed time to the nearest five minutes. Apply the same rounding to shifts that cross midnight.

Add seat booking to the existing seating module in task.mjs. A customer can book a free seat, look up who holds a seat, and release their own booking so another customer can book it. Reject booking an occupied seat and releasing someone else's seat. Keep the existing seat-label behavior.
api: Export createBooking() from task.mjs. Its returned object has book(seat, customer), holder(seat), and release(seat, customer). Book and release return booleans; holder returns the customer or null.
reference: export function createBooking() { const seats = new Map(); return { book(seat, customer) { if (seats.has(seat)) return false; seats.set(seat, customer); return true; }, holder(seat) { return seats.get(seat) ?? null; }, release(seat, customer) { if (!seats.has(seat) || seats.get(seat) !== customer) return false; return seats.delete(seat); } }; }
functional: const a = api.createBooking(), b = api.createBooking(); assert.equal(a.holder(1), null); assert.equal(a.book(1, 'Ana'), true); assert.equal(a.book(1, 'Bo'), false); assert.equal(a.holder(1), 'Ana'); assert.equal(b.holder(1), null); assert.equal(a.release(1, 'Bo'), false); assert.equal(a.release(1, 'Ana'), true); assert.equal(a.holder(1), null); assert.equal(a.book(1, 'Bo'), true);

prompt: Fix overlapMinutes in task.mjs. Disjoint appointments currently produce a negative overlap. Return zero for disjoint or touching appointments and keep the overlap duration for intersecting appointments. Each appointment is a pair of minute offsets with start at or before end.
starter: export function overlapMinutes(a, b) { return Math.min(a[1], b[1]) - Math.max(a[0], b[0]); }
reference: export function overlapMinutes(a, b) { return Math.max(0, Math.min(a[1], b[1]) - Math.max(a[0], b[0])); }

prompt: Add a library hold queue in task.mjs. Patrons can join a title's queue, cancel their hold, and collect the next hold. Joining twice keeps the original place. Collection is first-come first-served, and holds on one title never affect another title. Match title strings exactly, including surrounding spaces. Keep the existing title-label behavior.
api: Export createHolds() from task.mjs. Its returned object has join(title, patron) and cancel(title, patron), both returning whether the queue changed, and collect(title), returning the next patron or null.
reference: export function createHolds() { const queues = new Map(); return { join(title, patron) { const queue = queues.get(title) ?? []; if (queue.includes(patron)) return false; queue.push(patron); queues.set(title, queue); return true; }, cancel(title, patron) { const queue = queues.get(title) ?? []; const index = queue.indexOf(patron); if (index < 0) return false; queue.splice(index, 1); return true; }, collect(title) { return queues.get(title)?.shift() ?? null; } }; }
functional: const q = api.createHolds(); assert.equal(q.collect('A'), null); assert.equal(q.join('A','Lee'), true); assert.equal(q.join('A','Pat'), true); assert.equal(q.join('B','Sam'), true); assert.equal(q.join('A','Lee'), false); assert.equal(q.cancel('B','Pat'), false); assert.equal(q.collect('A'), 'Lee'); assert.equal(q.cancel('A','Pat'), true); assert.equal(q.collect('A'), null); assert.equal(q.collect('B'), 'Sam'); assert.equal(q.join('A', 'Ana'), true); assert.equal(q.join(' A ', 'Bo'), true); assert.equal(q.collect(' A '), 'Bo'); assert.equal(q.collect('A'), 'Ana');
